compare.browse.prompt.description: Compare By Content: the accept button of the file dialog that picks a file to compare.

compare.button.compare.description: Compare By Content: button that compares again. Keep it short.

compare.button.next.description: Compare By Content: button; N is its key. Keep it short.

compare.button.previous.description: Compare By Content: button; P is its key. Keep it short.

compare.need_two_files.description: Notification when Compare By Content has no two files to compare.
compare.need_two_files.message: Put the cursor on a file in each panel, or mark two files.

compare.option.binary.description: Compare By Content: check box, byte by byte instead of line by line.

compare.option.only_differences.description: Compare By Content: check box, hides the equal lines.

compare.status.bytes_differ.description: Compare By Content's status line, binary; place = compare.status.difference_of or compare.status.differences; count = the bytes that differ, grouped = the same number with its digits grouped, e.g. 1 234 567; first = the first one's offset, left and right = the files' sizes in bytes, e.g. 1 024.
compare.status.bytes_differ.message: {place}: {count, plural, one {{grouped} byte differs} other {{grouped} bytes differ}}, the first at {first}; sizes {left} and {right}.

compare.status.comparing.description: Compare By Content's status line while it compares.

compare.status.difference_of.description: Compare By Content's status line; at = the difference shown, count = how many, e.g. Difference 2 of 7.

compare.status.differences.description: Compare By Content's status line before one is chosen; count = how many, e.g. 7.

compare.status.identical.description: Compare By Content's status line, binary: count = the files' size in bytes, grouped = the same number with its digits grouped, e.g. 1 234 567.
compare.status.identical.message: {count, plural, one {The files are identical: {grouped} byte.} other {The files are identical: {grouped} bytes.}}

compare.status.no_differences.description: Compare By Content's status line: the texts are the same.

compare.window.title.description: Compare By Content window's title; left and right = the two files' names, e.g. old.txt and new.txt.

media.cannot_play.description: Video or sound in the viewer, over the picture; err = why, often from libmpv.

media.cannot_play_as_text.description: Video or sound in the viewer, in place of the player; err = why, often from libmpv. 1 is the key that switches the viewer to plain text.
media.cannot_play_as_text.message: This cannot be played: {err}. 1 shows it as text.

media.continuing.description: Video in the viewer, a badge for a few seconds when it goes on where it was left; time = the position, e.g. 1:02:05.

media.error.missing.description: Why video or sound cannot play; Settings > Add-ons is the Settings dialog's page, use their translated names; script = a build script's name, e.g. build.sh.
media.error.missing.message: libmpv is missing: Settings > Add-ons downloads it (a source build: vendor/mpv/{script})

media.error.not_started.description: Why video or sound cannot play.

media.error.too_long.description: Why a HEIC/AVIF picture or a video's frame could not be drawn; path = the file, e.g. /home/anna/IMG_0001.heic.

media.error.unsupported_system.description: Why video cannot play on another system; starts lowercase.
media.error.unsupported_system.message: video is played only on Linux, macOS and Windows yet

quick_view.counting.description: Quick View panel on a folder, while its size is counted.

quick_view.downloading.description: Quick View panel, while a server's file is fetched to be shown.

quick_view.empty.description: Quick View panel, when the other panel's cursor is on nothing to show.
quick_view.empty.message: Quick View shows what the other panel's cursor is on.

quick_view.extracting.description: Quick View panel, while a file is unpacked from an archive to be shown.
quick_view.extracting.message: Taking it out of the archive…

quick_view.files_only.description: Quick View panel, when the cursor is on a folder on a server or in an archive.
quick_view.files_only.message: On servers and inside archives, Quick View shows files.

quick_view.space.title.description: Quick View panel on a folder, as Total Commander's: the line above the totals.

quick_view.space.totals.description: Quick View panel on a folder: what is in it; bytes, files and folders = the counts, each *_grouped the same with its digits grouped, e.g. 1 234 567.
quick_view.space.totals.message: {bytes, plural, one {{bytes_grouped} byte} other {{bytes_grouped} bytes}} in {files, plural, one {{files_grouped} file} other {{files_grouped} files}}, {folders, plural, one {{folders_grouped} folder} other {{folders_grouped} folders}}

quick_view.space.unreadable.description: Quick View panel on a folder: how many files or folders could not be read, e.g. 3.

quick_view.too_large.download.description: Quick View panel; size = the file's size, e.g. 1.2 GB. F3 is the key of the viewer.
quick_view.too_large.download.message: {size} is too large to download here: F3 views it.

quick_view.too_large.extract.description: Quick View panel; size = the file's size, e.g. 1.2 GB. F3 is the key of the viewer.
quick_view.too_large.extract.message: {size} is too large to take out of the archive here: F3 views it.

viewer.as_text_hint.description: Viewer, in place of a picture or a converted document that cannot be shown; err = why, often the system's own text. 1 is the key that switches the viewer to plain text.

viewer.book.cannot_read.description: Viewer, in place of an EPUB/FB2/MOBI book; err = why (one of the viewer.book.error texts, or the system's). 1 is the key that switches the viewer to plain text.
viewer.book.cannot_read.message: This book cannot be read: {err}. 1 shows the file as text.

viewer.book.continuing.description: Viewer, a badge for a few seconds when a book opens where it was left; percent = how far in, e.g. 38%.

viewer.book.error.compression.description: Viewer: why a book cannot be read, shown after "This book cannot be read:"; starts lowercase. compression = the format's number, e.g. 17480.
viewer.book.error.compression.message: compressed in a way not read yet ({compression})

viewer.book.error.damaged.description: Viewer: why a book cannot be read, shown after "This book cannot be read:"; starts lowercase.

viewer.book.error.damaged_zip.description: Viewer: why a book cannot be read, shown after "This book cannot be read:"; starts lowercase. An EPUB is a zip file.

viewer.book.error.drm.description: Viewer: why a book cannot be read, shown after "This book cannot be read:"; starts lowercase. Kindle is Amazon's reader: not translated.
viewer.book.error.drm.message: DRM-protected: only Kindle can read it

viewer.book.error.huffman.description: Viewer: why a book cannot be read, shown after "This book cannot be read:"; starts lowercase. HUFF/CDIC is the format's name.
viewer.book.error.huffman.message: compressed as Amazon's own books are (HUFF/CDIC), which is not read yet

viewer.book.error.missing_part.description: Viewer: why a book cannot be read, shown after "This book cannot be read:"; starts lowercase. name = a file inside the EPUB, e.g. OEBPS/chapter1.xhtml.

viewer.book.error.no_package.description: Viewer: why a book cannot be read, shown after "This book cannot be read:"; starts lowercase. The package file is the EPUB's list of contents (content.opf).
viewer.book.error.no_package.message: no package file in the book

viewer.book.error.no_text.description: Viewer: why a book cannot be read, shown after "This book cannot be read:"; starts lowercase.

viewer.book.error.not_zip.description: Viewer: why a book cannot be read, shown after "This book cannot be read:"; starts lowercase. An EPUB is a zip file.
viewer.book.error.not_zip.message: not a zip: a damaged or a DRM-protected book?

viewer.book.error.zip_method.description: Viewer: why a book cannot be read, shown after "This book cannot be read:"; starts lowercase. name = a file inside the EPUB, e.g. OEBPS/chapter1.xhtml; method = the zip compression's number, e.g. 14.
viewer.book.error.zip_method.message: {name}: compressed as zip cannot read here ({method})

viewer.cannot_show.description: Quick View, when the file under the other panel's cursor cannot be opened; err = the system's reason.

viewer.convert.failed.description: Viewer, why an office document is not shown; tool = the converter, e.g. WordCraft; status = the program's exit status in the system's words, e.g. exit status: 1.

viewer.converting.description: Viewer, while an office document is turned into PDF; tool = the converter, e.g. WordCraft.

viewer.copy.too_large.description: Viewer, notification on Copy; megabytes = the limit, e.g. 64.
viewer.copy.too_large.message: Selections over {megabytes} MB are not copied.

viewer.find.not_found.description: Viewer › Find, notification; text = what was searched for.

viewer.find.not_hex.description: Viewer › Find with Hex on, when the text is not hexadecimal bytes; text = what was typed, e.g. 4G 1F.

viewer.find.nothing.description: Viewer › Find, when the search text is empty.

viewer.find.save_failed.description: Viewer › Find, notification when the search history cannot be written; err = the system's reason.

viewer.loading.description: Viewer, while a picture is read.

viewer.markdown.too_large.description: Viewer, in italics in place of a Markdown file too large to render; megabytes = the limit, e.g. 4. 1 is the key that switches the viewer to plain text.
viewer.markdown.too_large.message: Over {megabytes} MB: 1 shows it as text.

viewer.menu.binary.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Options: a viewing mode. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.book.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Options: a viewing mode. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.close.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, File. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.configure.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Options. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.copy_hex.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, the text's right-click menu: copies the selection as hexadecimal bytes. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.copy_text.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Edit and the text's right-click menu. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.edit.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar: a menu's name, as Total Commander's Lister has it. Keep it short.

viewer.menu.encoding.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar: a menu's name, as Total Commander's Lister has it. Keep it short.

viewer.menu.file.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar: a menu's name, as Total Commander's Lister has it. Keep it short.

viewer.menu.find.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Edit. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.font_ascii.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Options: the font's character set. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.font_page.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Encoding, the first item: the code page follows the ANSI/ASCII font choice. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.font_variable.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Options: a proportional font instead of a fixed-width one. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.hex.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Options: a viewing mode (hexadecimal dump). "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.minimap.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Options, a check item: the narrow overview of the text at the right. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.next_file.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, File. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.only_larger.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Options, a check item: small pictures stay at 100%. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.open.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, File. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.options.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar: a menu's name, as Total Commander's Lister has it. Keep it short.

viewer.menu.picture.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Options: a viewing mode. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.previous_file.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, File. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.reload.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, File. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.save_as.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, File. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.search_google.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, the text's right-click menu. "..." means a dialog opens.
viewer.menu.search_google.message: Search for selected text with Google

viewer.menu.select_all.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Edit. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.syntax_colors.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Options, a check item: source code coloured by its language. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.text_only.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Options: a viewing mode. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.unicode.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Options: a viewing mode. "..." means a dialog opens.

viewer.menu.wrap.description: Viewer (F3) menu bar, Options, a check item; columns = the line length set in Settings, e.g. 80.
viewer.menu.wrap.message: Wrap text ({columns, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}})

viewer.mode.binary.description: Viewer's status bar (and scmd's): the viewing mode and its code page; page = the code page's number, e.g. 1250. Keep it short.

viewer.mode.book.description: Viewer's status bar (and scmd's): the viewing mode. Keep it short.

viewer.mode.hex.description: Viewer's status bar (and scmd's): the viewing mode and its code page; page = the code page's number, e.g. 1250. Keep it short.

viewer.mode.html.description: Viewer's status bar (and scmd's): the viewing mode. Keep it short.

viewer.mode.image.description: Viewer's status bar (and scmd's): the viewing mode. Keep it short.

viewer.mode.multimedia.description: Viewer's status bar (and scmd's): the viewing mode. Keep it short.

viewer.mode.pdf_by.description: Viewer's status bar: an office document shown as PDF; tool = the converter, e.g. WordCraft.

viewer.mode.text.description: Viewer's status bar (and scmd's): the viewing mode and its code page; page = the code page's number, e.g. 1250. Keep it short.

viewer.origin.not_editable.description: Error on F4 Edit of a file inside an archive that cannot be updated; starts lowercase, it follows the file's name.
viewer.origin.not_editable.message: only files in 7z, zip, jar and tar archives can be edited

viewer.origin.updated.description: Notification after an edited file went back into its archive; archive = its name, e.g. photos.zip.

viewer.origin.updated_on.description: Notification after an edited file went back into its archive on a server; archive = its name, e.g. photos.zip; server = its address, e.g. sftp://anna@example.com.

viewer.origin.uploaded.description: Notification after an edited file went back to its server; path = the file on the server, e.g. /var/www/index.html.

viewer.pdf.cannot_show.description: Viewer, in place of a PDF; err = why, from PDFium or the system.

viewer.pdf.loading.description: Viewer's status bar while a PDF opens.

viewer.pdf.page.description: Viewer's status bar for a PDF; page = the page at the top, pages = how many there are, e.g. Page 3 / 12. Keep it short.

viewer.picture.cannot_show.description: Viewer, in place of a picture it cannot draw. 1 is the key that switches the viewer to plain text.
viewer.picture.cannot_show.message: This picture cannot be shown; 1 shows it as text.

viewer.save_as.failed.description: Viewer › File › Save as, notification; path = the new file, err = the system's reason.

viewer.status.rows.description: Viewer's status bar: the rows on screen; first and last = the rows shown, e.g. 1 201 and 1 240; count = all the rows, grouped = the same number with its digits grouped, e.g. 1 234 567.
viewer.status.rows.message: {count, plural, one {{first}–{last} of {grouped} row} other {{first}–{last} of {grouped} rows}}

viewer.status.rows_so_far.description: Viewer's status bar while a large file is still read; count = the rows found so far, grouped = the same number with its digits grouped, e.g. 1 234 567; percent = how much is read, e.g. 38%.
viewer.status.rows_so_far.message: {count, plural, one {{grouped} row so far, {percent} read} other {{grouped} rows so far, {percent} read}}

viewer.status.searching.description: Viewer's status bar while Find looks through the file.

viewer.status.size.description: Viewer's status bar: the file's size; count = the bytes, grouped = the same number with its digits grouped, e.g. 1 234 567.

viewer.window.title.description: Viewer window's title; path = the file shown, e.g. /home/anna/notes.txt.

viewer.zoom.fit.description: Viewer's status bar: tooltip of the zoom percentage button, for a picture.

viewer.zoom.in.description: Viewer's status bar: tooltip of the + zoom button.

viewer.zoom.out.description: Viewer's status bar: tooltip of the − zoom button.

viewer.zoom.reset.description: Viewer's status bar: tooltip of the zoom percentage button, for text.
